main.description: A guess at one of a puzzle's answers. No correctness field: verdicts are computed by the AppView at render time against the puzzle's answer key, so an answer-key correction can retroactively reclassify old attempts. No author field: authorship is structural, carried by whichever account's own repo the record lives in. Scoped to the author and the puzzle: one attempt per answer per account, regardless of which team(s) the account is attempting it through.

answerId.description: The opaque id of the specific answer, within the referenced puzzle, this attempt is targeting. Omitted for most puzzles: submissions are checked against the whole answer pool rather than a single answer up front, so which (if any) answer matched is only known after checking. Reserved for puzzle types where a guess is inherently tied to one specific answer up front (e.g. multiple-choice) -- not used yet.
